read.thesis: Orders up 11% and unsold completed homes down 35% show disciplined supply, but pre-tax margin fell to 10.7% in homebuilding and incentives stay elevated, with FY26 guidance held.

triggers.label: Unsold completed homes down 35%
triggers.quote: reducing unsold completed homes by 35% from a year ago

triggers.label: Net sales orders up 11%
triggers.quote: driving an 11% year‑over‑year increase in net sales orders
triggers.highlight: 11% year‑over‑year increase in net sales orders

triggers.label: Incentives to stay elevated
triggers.quote: We expect our sales incentives to remain elevated in fiscal 2026

guidance.quote: Consolidated revenues in the range of $33.5 billion to $34.5 billion
Homes closed by homebuilding operations of 86,000 homes to 87,500 homes
Consolidated cash flow provided by operations of at least $3.0 billion

red_flags.label: Margin supported by litigation and warranty one-off
red_flags.quote: include a 40 basis point benefit from a favorable litigation outcome and lower warranty costs
